MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.

3. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.

4. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

5. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.

6. When practising Reading for Understanding, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Understanding.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Understanding.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Understanding.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Understanding.

----
